parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is state-tolerated targeting: police torture of LGBT people in custody (2013), forced anal examinations and a police-led 'witch hunt' committee (2018), deportation of HIV workers (2017), plus a severe 2024 abduction and mutilation of a trans activist and a 2024 report of escalating weaponisation of law. That is tier-2 exposure with thin recourse (documented lack of access to justice, poor human-rights record, declining speech/assembly, LGBT website blocking). No trans-specific presentation offence is documented, but the sodomy/gross-indecency framework operates as a police lever against visibly gender-nonconforming people, as the custody record shows. Some dated positives: media hate-speech ethics and non-discrimination care language, but enforcement is unestablished. The subnational jurisdiction adds female same-sex criminalisation; enforcement status is unresolved. Recourse is weak, rule of law works against LGBT people.
